page_title: NAP 0-0 PAR | Napoli v Parma 14/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Lorenzo Lucca (Napoli) sends a chip pass into the box, but Filippo Rinaldi is quickest to intercept the ball.
90+3' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
90+3' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
90+2' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle as Lorenzo Lucca (Napoli) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Here is a change. Christian Ordonez is going off and Carlos Cuesta gives the last tactical orders to Adrian Benedyczak (Parma).
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and David Neres leaves the pitch and Lorenzo Lucca (Napoli) comes on.
90' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) commits a foul and Michael Fabbri immediately signals a free kick.
87' David Neres (Napoli) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
85' Scott McTominay (Napoli) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
84' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards the top of the net, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Filippo Rinaldi.
84' Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
81' A yellow-coloured card is received by Filippo Rinaldi (Parma).
80' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) brings his opponent down. Michael Fabbri has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
79' Matteo Politano goes off the pitch and Antonio Vergara (Napoli) comes on.
76' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
74' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 3:1.
71' Scott McTominay (Napoli) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the roof of the net, but Filippo Rinaldi is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
69' Mariano Troilo will be replaced by Enrico Del Prato (Parma).
67' Sascha Britschgi (Parma) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Michael Fabbri had an easy-decision to make.
65' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) outjumps his marker and heads the resulting corner high over the bar.
65' Matteo Politano (Napoli) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
65' David Neres (Napoli) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. The ball goes out for a corner. Napoli can continue in their attacking effort.
64' David Neres (Napoli) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
62' Filippo Rinaldi displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
59' Carlos Cuesta decides to make a substitution. Jacob Ondrejka will be replaced by Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma).
58' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Patrick Cutrone.
58' Here comes a substitution. Noa Lang is given a rest as he is replaced by David Neres (Napoli).
58' Cristian Stellini prepares a substitution. Pasquale Mazzocchi is replaced by Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli).
58' Here's the change. Mathias Olivera leaves the pitch and Eljif Elmas (Napoli) comes on as a substitute.
58' Mariano Troilo (Parma) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
55' Napoli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

55' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Noa Lang (Napoli) finds some space inside the box and fires a volley at goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender. Napoli have been awarded a corner kick.
55' Matteo Politano (Napoli) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
49' Matteo Politano (Napoli) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
48' Referee Michael Fabbri signals NO PENALTY for Napoli after a VAR review!
48' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Napoli! Let's see what he decides.
48' Surely that's handball by one of the Parma players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
47' Scott McTominay (Napoli) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety.
46' Carlos Cuesta makes a half-time substitution. Emanuele Valeri (Parma) comes on in place of Oliver Sorensen.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' An attempted cross from Matteo Politano (Napoli) is cleared.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.

43' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma. Mathias Olivera (Napoli) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
40' A corner kick by Parma is thwarted by the well prepared Vanja Milinkovic-Savic (Napoli).

40' Lautaro Valenti (Parma) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball is out of play. Parma will have a chance to score from a corner.
39' Noa Lang (Napoli) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
36' Oliver Sorensen (Parma) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
33' The ball is crossed into the box and Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the bottom left corner, but Filippo Rinaldi gets a glove on it to thwart him.
33' The goalkeeper denies the long-range shot from Jacob Ondrejka (Parma). It wasn't such a big threat for him.
32' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.

27' Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Filippo Rinaldi, who pulls off a comfortable save!
26' Noa Lang (Napoli) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
26' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. Napoli are awarded a corner kick.
24' Noa Lang (Napoli) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
23' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
22' Noa Lang (Napoli) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
17' Wonderful movement by Parma. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
14' The goal by Napoli is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
12' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Napoli players aren’t happy.
11' Goal! A rebound wrong foots everyone except Scott McTominay (Napoli), and he slams the ball into the open net from close range. 1:0.
8' Noa Lang (Napoli) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
6' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
6' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. Napoli force a corner. They send men into the box.
4' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the right post.
